content.text: Run the shell command `sleep 5` and tell me when done.

The command is expected to complete within a specific timeframe, so adjusting the timeout parameter might be necessary to ensure the command runs to completion. It seems best to set a larger value to avoid premature backgrounding. Using 5000 as the timeout value looks reasonable, as the command is designed to sleep for 5 seconds.
